defects.what: Share list puts Cold brew (7.1%) above Tea (14.7%): follows the stack order, not the size order, so the percentages read out of sequence
Callout 1 has a navy accent bar while 2 and 3 have drink colours (amber, sea-foam); amber suggests drip, so the accent colours carry a meaning they don't have
Value labels above the bars are small (about 11 px) and light next to the large serif headings
Serif display face embedded as an unnamed Type 3 font; renders correctly but isn't selectable or searchable as named text

IRQG.craft_notes: The most refined of the three. It pairs a serif display face with a sans body, uses a four-swatch colour key as a header mark, bolds the busiest month on the axis, and sets the share legend as a ruled list with right-aligned serif percentages. Bars are to scale: about 0.147 px per cup, the same in every month, and segment heights match the totals. The monthly totals add up to 35,280 and the four drinks also sum to 35,280. Every percentage rounds correctly to one decimal place. The PNG, SVG and PDF match. The margins and rhythm are even; the only spare space is a small amount of air around the donut.
IRQG.revision_notes: All the numbers are updated correctly: Dec 3,330, total 35,630, busiest month December, cold brew peak still August 420, drinks 15,900/11,960/2,510/5,260, and shares 44.6/33.6/7.0/14.8. The measured Dec bar segments are about 1,488/1,115/88/632. Tea is plum in the bars, donut, legend, list and header key, and the PNG, SVG and PDF all match. The bold axis highlight moved from Aug to Dec, which follows from the change. One collateral change: the source line now reads 'coffee-2025.csv, December corrected'.

defects.what: '35,280 cups' in large slab bold fills the donut hole, and the numerals nearly touch the inner ring
Section headings and chart start at x≈88, while the title, rule, callouts and footnote start at x≈60: two left margins
The donut legend sits far to the right of the donut with a wide gap. The values are crammed against the names ('Drip  11,880') and not aligned in a column
Dead band of about 150 px under the donut and about 80 px below the footnote; the footnote floats
Straight apostrophe in "year's" in a display heading
Legend is centred over the chart while the heading above it is left-aligned

RYGP.craft_notes: Characterful type (a slab display face with a humanist sans) and strong navy callout cards with amber figures. The data is correct: bars are to scale at about 0.1385 px per cup in every month, and the totals, shares and callouts are all consistent. The layout lets it down. The chart and share sections are indented from the page margin. The donut centre label is too big for its hole. The legend is detached and the values aren't aligned. Space is unevenly spread, with a large empty band at the bottom. The SVG is all outlined paths (no live text), which is acceptable. The PDF has embedded named fonts.
RYGP.revision_notes: All the numbers are updated correctly (35,630; December 3,330; August 420; 15,900/11,960/2,510/5,260; 44.6/33.6/7.0/14.8%), and the Dec bar is drawn to scale. Tea is plum in the bars, donut and legend, and the PNG, SVG and PDF all match. One collateral change: the decorative coral rule under the subtitle was also recoloured to plum. Everything else is pixel-identical outside the changed regions. The donut-centre crowding remains.

defects.what: Single generic sans (DejaVu) throughout. Competent, but it gives the piece a default-template feel
Callouts 1 and 2 share the amber accent bar while callout 3 uses sea-foam, so the accent colours carry an inconsistent meaning (amber is also drip)
Cup counts sit at the far right, detached from their rows by a wide gap
SVG is sized 864×1296 pt rather than 1200×1800; scales correctly but is an odd unit choice

VNPK.craft_notes: Clean, well-ordered and accurate. A navy header band, three white callout cards, and a full-width stacked bar chart with bold total labels. The share section pairs a donut with a large-percentage list. Bars are to scale at about 0.147 px per cup, consistent across months. The totals add up to 35,280, the drinks sum to 35,280, and the percentages round correctly. Edges are crisp in the PNG and the vectors. The design is generic: one sans face, and white cards on cream make the page a little flat. Even so, nothing is broken.
VNPK.revision_notes: All the numbers are updated correctly: total 35,630, busiest month 3,330 in December, cold brew peak August 420, drinks 15,900/11,960/2,510/5,260, and shares 44.6/33.6/7.0/14.8. The Dec bar measures about 1,488/1,121/88/639 cups. Tea is plum in the bars, legend, donut and list, and the PNG, SVG and PDF all match. One collateral change: the source line now reads 'coffee-2025.csv (Dec corrected)'. Nothing else moved.

pairwise_round1.why: IRQG has even margins and a well-set share list. RYGP has a crowded donut centre, two left margins and a dead band at the bottom.
Both are accurate and clean; IRQG's serif and sans pairing and its small refinements (colour key, bold peak month, ruled list) lift it above VNPK's single default sans.
VNPK's layout is consistent and fully finished, while RYGP's better typefaces don't make up for its misaligned sections, crowded donut label and uneven spacing.
